traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The hound has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound’s al- lies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The hound makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage. Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
